title: The AI helper on gym web pages spends MettleUp's AI money without counting it anywhere
what: Each answer from the AI helper on a gym's web page is a paid AI call. Its cost is only written to a passing log line. It is not added to the AI usage tally that the other AI features use, so no month total, no all-gyms ceiling and no warning can include it. The gym's own credits limit each gym, but MettleUp cannot see what the helper costs in total.
expected: Every web-page helper answer is added to the same AI usage tally as the other AI features, so HQ shows its cost and warns before a monthly amount is passed.
how_often: every AI helper answer, once the helper is switched on
fix_line: Record each helper answer and its cost in the shared AI usage tally and include it in HQ's month total

title: The per-visitor limits on gym web page forms switch off quietly when the small web store fails or is full
what: Ask the gym, Report this page and the AI helper count sends per network address in Cloudflare's small free web store. When that store is missing, broken or over its free daily write limit, the count is skipped and every send goes through. Only a log line says so; nobody at MettleUp is warned, and the only brake left is each gym's own daily limit, which one visitor can then use up.
expected: MettleUp is warned before the web store nears its free daily limit, and is told at once when the per-visitor count stops working.
how_often: whenever the web store is down or over its free limit
fix_line: Raise an HQ alert when the per-visitor count cannot be used, and watch the web store's daily writes
